Indicator: Aridity index (P/PET; Hargreaves PET)
Question answered: How much of the atmospheric water demand does rainfall meet, now and as it warms?
Dataset: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2 (daily pr, tas, tasmax, tasmin)
Scenarios / models: Common complete ensemble of 25 models (nex_ensemble_models_used.csv); stage 30 builds historical + SSP1-2.6 and SSP2-4.5 (near, mid, late). SSP3-7.0 and SSP5-8.5 folders exist in data/raw but are not processed.
Access / licence: Open (per-model CC0 / CC BY; see tech note)
Motivation: Combines rainfall and evaporative demand, so it captures warming-driven drying that the rainfall indicators miss, and varies between places in the baseline.
Notes: Same source, periods and ensemble as the other 201 metrics; PET is written as pet_hargreaves_nex_{period}_*. Not standardised per cell, so the baseline has spatial contrast. Overlaps with annual_rainfall (P is the numerator).
